question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH food_dim AS (
    SELECT
        FOOD_ID,
        COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) AS CATEGORY_VARIANTS,
        MAX(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) AS FOOD_CATEGORY
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__FOOD
    GROUP BY FOOD_ID
),
classified_lines AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN f.CATEGORY_VARIANTS = 1 AND f.FOOD_CATEGORY = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
            WHEN f.CATEGORY_VARIANTS = 1 AND f.FOOD_CATEGORY = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS FOOD_GROUP,
        i.QUANTITY
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o
    JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM i
        ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
    LEFT JOIN food_dim f
        ON f.FOOD_ID = i.F_ID
    WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
group_totals AS (
    SELECT FOOD_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT, SUM(QUANTITY) AS ORDERED_UNITS
    FROM classified_lines
    GROUP BY FOOD_GROUP
),
groups AS (
    SELECT column1 AS FOOD_GROUP
    FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
),
denominator AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS
    FROM classified_lines
)
SELECT
    g.FOOD_GROUP,
    COALESCE(t.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT,
    COALESCE(t.ORDERED_UNITS, 0) AS ORDERED_UNITS,
    d.TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS,
    CASE
        WHEN d.TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(t.ORDERED_UNITS, 0) * 100.0 / d.TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS
    END AS SHARE_OF_TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS_PCT
FROM groups g
LEFT JOIN group_totals t ON t.FOOD_GROUP = g.FOOD_GROUP
CROSS JOIN denominator d
ORDER BY CASE g.FOOD_GROUP WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

action.answer:
For item lines belonging to orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025:

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of total ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null or unmatched food ID) | 12 | 13 | 0.000106% |

The denominator is **12,230,877 ordered units** across all three groups. Shares are each group’s ordered units divided by this denominator, multiplied by 100. Values may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.
